camel_example: aliyun gpdb CreateIndex --region cn-hangzhou --Collection testcollection --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --NamespacePassword testpassword --Namespace mynamespace
description_en:
Creates an index.

Usage notes:
Only scalar indexes are supported.
Write operations on the table are prohibited during index creation.
Creating an index on a table with a large amount of data consumes CPU and I/O resources of the instance. If instance availability is affected, call CancelCreateIndexJob to cancel the index creation
description_zh:
创建索引。

说明：
只支持创建标量索引。
创建索引期间禁写表。
在单表数据量大的情况下创建索引，过程中会占用实例CPU、IO资源，如果影响实例可用性请调用CancelCreateIndexJob取消创建索引
kebab_example: aliyun gpdb create-index --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --namespace mynamespace --namespace-password testpassword --collection testcollection --region cn-hangzhou
